entities.name: Tromokratis
entities.description: A cantankerous nadir kraken that claims all of the sea of Theros as its territory.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The sea god, perhaps commanding Tromokratis.

entities.name: Pyrgnos
entities.description: Meletis's repository of scholarly knowledge, toppled by Tromokratis.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A polis that has kept a watch for Tromokratis.

entities.name: Humenades
entities.description: A hero who used a magic horn to summon Tromokratis to destroy a cursed city.

entities.name: Tizerus
entities.description: Place where Humenades buried the magic horn.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God whose palace lies near the buried horn.

events.summary: In 4551 AR Tromokratis rose from the waves and toppled the Pyrgnos in Meletis.
events.quote: the massive kraken rose from the waves to topple the Pyrgnos

events.summary: In ancient times Humenades used a magic horn to summon Tromokratis to destroy a cursed city, then buried the horn at Tizerus.
events.quote: Humenades took it to Tizerus and buried it under a stone

relations.note: The polis has watched for it since it toppled the Pyrgnos.
relations.quote: the polis has kept a watch specifically for Tromokratis
